limitations: Unpinned processes inherited all available CPUs on a shared host; no exclusive-machine speed claims.
Generic untagged T/U benchmark fixtures are rejected by current admission and retained as rejections.
Full phase harness failed baseline completed-rerun structural equality on axial_even4_10; exact expressions retained, no component-equality claim.
Source-only phase harness exposed unsupported raw gamma signatures in some inputs; per-source attempts retain every refusal.
Preexisting Sep27 executable measurements are diagnostic only and do not represent current source baseline.
No independent correctness oracle is implied by term counts or unchanged snapshots.
